title: 连接凡科建站
description: 请填写网站后台申请的 API Key，并确认站点已开启 AI 接口开放。WorkBuddy 将凭证保存在用户本机，连接时发送至凡科建站服务进行鉴权。
description_en: Enter the API key obtained from your site administration panel and enable AI interface access. WorkBuddy stores the credential locally and sends it to the Faisco service when connecting.

fields.label: API Key
fields.placeholder: 填写您在网站后台申请的 API Key
fields.description: 用于查询或管理该密钥获准访问的站点文章。请使用您自己的密钥，不要在对话中粘贴或公开分享。
fields.description_en: Used to access site articles permitted by this key. Use your own key; do not paste it into conversations or share it publicly.
